verdict.rationale: Stable has a public pricing page that lists plan contents: basic mail actions (scan, ship, shred), one street address, user limits, API/webhooks, AI summaries and a 30-day money-back guarantee. Marketing copy also mentions free high-res scans and discounted forwarding rates. None of the evidence shows actual dollar figures, scan allowances or per-item fees, so the 'complete' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: monthly plan price, numeric scan allowances, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage and check deposit, and independent corroboration of the pricing page's completeness.

support.subject: As a founder, plan pricing is public and complete — monthly price, scan allowances, and the per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit

citations.quote: Basic mail actions (scan, ship, shred) 1 permanent street address 1 user (3 max paid users) Unlimited recipients API and webhooks AI summaries
All plans come with change of address guidance and a 30-day money back guarantee.
Scan: Get free high-res scans of internal mail contents.
Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included.
